# Tugays

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online store for home, kitchen, bathroom and organization items, toys and small household appliances, with branches in Montevideo. Ships nationwide at a flat fee and offers free pickup in branches.

*ES:* Tienda online uruguaya de hogar, cocina, baño, organización, juguetes y electrohogar, con sucursales en Montevideo. Envía a todo el país con costo fijo y ofrece retiro gratis en sucursales.
